entries.zh: 那就不必了；免了（客套之辞）
entries.en: that would be superfluous; consider it excused
entries.notes: H 栏存 [疑:免/兑]，M「Bien」与「免」对音，义取免。

entries.zh: 不必多礼；客套话就免了
entries.en: no need for ceremony; compliments are excused
entries.notes: M 栏调符污损（T99），L 为完整句 escusados son cumplimientos。

entries.en: no need to bow; bowing is excused
entries.notes: L 缩写 cumplimtos 已展开，H 有 [疑]、调符 T03。

entries.en: the sphere of the sun; the sun's orb
to force oneself to do something; to strive
entries.notes: M 栏「quiõ-l. quiàng」两读残损，义依 H「强」与 L「esforçarse a...」。

entries.zh: 奋发；从虚弱中振作起来
entries.en: to exert oneself; to summon strength out of weakness
entries.notes: L 讹作「saçar fuera ð flaqueça」，即 sacar fuerça de flaqueza；M 栏尾「enfojarr,」不成词。

entries.en: to force oneself to do something; to do by main force
to force oneself to eat, as an invalid does
entries.notes: 两处调符污损（T99）；H 第三字「企」与 M「nge」（硬）不合，疑讹。

entries.en: to struggle to get up; to raise oneself
entries.notes: R 栏「giin bi」与 H「爬起来」不对应，疑污损或错行。

entries.en: to fence; to brandish a weapon
entries.notes: H「抚」与 L「esgrimir」不合，疑为「舞」之讹（M 亦作 Bu）。

entries.en: to practise staff-play; to brandish a stick
entries.notes: M 首字调符污损（T99），L 末「flacy」残讹不明。

entries.en: to fence with the same stick; to put on a fist-play display
entries.notes: L 言「同一根棍棒」，与 H「拳花」小异；R 仅存「fa」。

entries.zh: 拳花；如戏台上所演的花拳
entries.en: fist-play flourish, as performed in stage plays

entries.zh: 演武步法；练武步势（原件残损，释义存疑）
entries.en: footwork of arms drill (text defective; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: M 栏混入下行「演武台」音写「ien bū tay」，H「捏步」义难定。

entries.zh: 灯谜；猜灯谜（一种猜谜游戏）
entries.en: lantern riddles; the game of guessing riddles
entries.notes: L 栏仍作 esgrimir，与 H「灯谜」不合，当系串行；义依 H 及 M 栏内嵌 Jugar adivinos。

entries.zh: 演武台；演练兵器的台场
entries.en: martial practice platform; drill ground for arms
a link of a chain; a small ring
entries.notes: 「圈」调符污损（T99），L、H、M 三栏义证一致。

entries.en: a linking ring; to hook together
entries.notes: L「.co. muni canse.」残讹难读，义依 H「相钩」与 M「siò cau」。
「火」调符污损（T99），L、H、M 义证一致；R 仅存「fo」。
